stories.title: S1 retained session experience
stories.text: As a session participant I can distinguish committed, provisional and incomplete history, and inspect the exact recorded body without affecting execution.

stories.title: S2 retained session experience
stories.text: As a participant I can keep reading a compact conversation and exact call changes while the terminal resizes and work continues.

stories.title: S3 retained session experience
stories.text: As a keyboard or mouse reader I can find, select, copy and export content and retain all current controls, with real terminal proof.
